events.text_en: Lệnh Hồ Chiêm, founder of Củng Tinh Quán, dies at the armillary at 470; his disciple Thẩm Bắc Thần becomes head.
Vệ Văn Cơ, a disciple of Củng Tinh Quán, leaves the abbey to lay formations for hire.

On the night Doãn Ngọc Hành holds the Bắc Thần Ấn and the Weight together, the pole star goes out in the water of Tinh Lạc Hồ. The lake watcher sees it; the head of Củng Tinh Quán sees it in his mirror, and says it was cloud.
